preToolUse.bash: if [ -n "$TOKENWISE_PROBE" ]; then tokenwise hook copilot; else cat >/dev/null; fi

sessionStart.bash: if command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1; then tokenwise hook copilot; else cat >/dev/null; echo '{"type":"progress","message":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/HKUDS/TokenWise#install"}'; fi
